name: popsicle
headline: Netflix Marketing Dashboard: Campaign Analytics
short_description: Netflix Marketing Campaign Dashboard built to analyze and visualize key performance metrics across regions, content types, and ad platforms.
author: GURLEENK26

sections.overview:
The Netflix Marketing Campaign Dashboard is a Power BI solution that visualizes key performance metrics for marketing campaigns across regions, content types, and advertising platforms. Built with DAX and data modeling, it provides actionable insights through total revenue and budget analysis, regional breakdowns, content type comparisons, and engagement metrics including conversion rates, impressions, and ROI. The dashboard features 100% interactive and dynamic capabilities with drill-down functionality and intuitive filters for regions, campaigns, and ad platforms, enabling data-driven marketing decisions.
Analyze regional revenue and budget performance across Netflix markets
Compare marketing effectiveness by content type (Series, Documentaries, Movies)
Track conversion rates and ROI by ad platform and campaign
Monitor engagement metrics and impressions across multiple regions
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/GURLEENK26/Netflix-Marketing-Campaign-Dashboard`
sections.usage:
```
Create a Netflix Marketing Campaign Dashboard to analyze and visualize key performance metrics across regions, content types, and ad platforms for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY]. Include metrics like impressions, click-through rates, conversions, and ROI. Provide insights on top-performing regions, content types, and ad platforms. Highlight trends and patterns over the last [TIME_PERIOD] months.
```
